description: Gate A-D edge search ledger for HK, following the same workflow as JPN/US500/XAUUSD/NASDAQ/DAX.

gate_a_2026-09-17.cost_bps_source: HK empirical p95-p99 bid/ask spread band (p95=6.648, p99=6.708), midpoint per config/us500_edge_search_ledger.json per_asset_empirical_spread_bps_2026-09-14

gate_c_2026-09-17.rule: Exact bid/ask tick replay on Gate B's top-3 finalists + control geometry. Filter to executable_r (meanR) STRICTLY > 0. Winner = argmax(R/occupied_day) among positive finalists. KILL if none positive. Applied to all 19 Gate A survivors.
gate_c_2026-09-17.recurring_bugs_fixed: build_tick_file_catalog() missing entirely on dailyrangecompletionfade_long and trendpullbackcontinuation_long; wrong dict-key schema (start/end instead of start_date/end_date/filename) on downsidevolatilitycascade_short, drawdownhazardcontinuation_short, drawupreversalhazard_short. Same recurring per-edge scaffold gaps as every prior asset, fixed identically each time.

task2a_2026-09-17.note: The 3 marginal Gate C survivors (drawupreversalhazard_short, trend_short, trendpullbackcontinuation_short -- all with R/occupied_day near zero) also had the 3 lowest Task2A coverage rates, all below the 0.99 minimum. Consistent pattern: thin/near-breakeven Gate C edges tend to have incomplete tick coverage near the end of available history.

gate_d_v3_2026-09-17.method: shared/edges/gate_d_calibration_monotonicity.py -- AUC-ROC/Mann-Whitney U on raw Step03 OOF predictions vs quote_executable_meta_label. PASS requires AUC>0.5 and p<0.05.

final_disposition_2026-09-17.summary: 3 of 21 HK edges deployable (14%). All 3 survivors are short-side. Killed-edge folders removed from config/edge_universe.json; folder deletion from disk pending user confirmation.

coverage_shorts1_2026-10-15.note: Cross-asset coverage campaign batch (config/cross_asset_thesis_coverage.json): export -> 2000-row floor -> Gate A/B default grid + FINE1 + FINE2 at the asset research cost.
